c: Woodbridge backyards get built up over generations, and eventually something in them has to come down before something better goes up. Live Junk Free tears it down and hauls it away in one visit. Around the older village streets, it’s a garage or a deck that came with the house a generation ago, demolished as the family finally renovates the yard their parents built. Through East and West Woodbridge’s larger lots, it’s above ground pool demolition and concrete removal ahead of a new outdoor kitchen or in-ground pool. In Pine Valley and Weston Downs, it’s larger structures — bigger decks, bigger sheds, sometimes a full garage — torn down with the same care given to the rest of an estate-sized property. And on properties changing hands between generations, it’s playsets, sheds and fences that haven’t been touched in years, cleared alongside the rest of the yard. The 700+ five-star Google reviews behind Live Junk Free come from every one of those backyards — a demolition crew that tore the structure down safely, protected the stonework and patio around it, and hauled every piece away the same visit.

blocks.text: DEMOLITION FAQ
Demolition Services in Woodbridge — What to Know Before You Book

items.q: How much does demolition cost in Woodbridge?
a: Price depends on the structure — a fence section or trampoline is a small job; a full above ground pool, garage or concrete patio costs more given the size, material and crew time involved. The exact figure is confirmed free at the walkthrough and covers teardown, haul-away and disposal together.

items.q: Do you protect our patio and stonework during demolition?
a: Yes, as standard. Woodbridge backyards are often built around stone patios and finished landscaping, and Live Junk Free protects those surfaces before the first piece of the structure comes down — it’s built into the quote, never itemized separately.

items.q: Can you demolish a pool ahead of a bigger backyard renovation?
a: Regularly. Above ground pool demolition — frame, liner and surrounding decking — gets timed to land before your landscaper, patio installer or in-ground pool crew arrives, so the space is ready when they show up.

items.q: What's involved in concrete or flooring demolition?
a: The patio, walkway or driveway surface gets broken up with equipment matched to its thickness and reinforcement, then hauled off in manageable pieces. The site is left level and cleared, ready for whatever’s replacing it.

items.q: We're clearing my parents' backyard as the property changes hands — can you help?
a: Regularly, and gently. Old sheds, playsets, decks or pools clear at the family’s pace, with discreet scheduling and documentation available if the estate or sale needs it.

items.q: Can you demolish a garage or shed on a larger Pine Valley or Weston Downs property?
a: Yes — larger properties are common work for us in Woodbridge, and the same standard of protection and care applies whatever the scale of the structure or the lot.

items.q: Can demolition happen the same day I call?
a: Often, yes. Trucks run Woodbridge daily, 6AM to 11PM, seven days a week, so a morning call frequently means an afternoon demolition — call +1 647 922 5865 for today’s real availability.

items.q: What happens to the materials after demolition?
a: Metal components go to recyclers, and wood, concrete and other materials are disposed of responsibly. Nothing goes to landfill that has a better destination.

items.q: Why are your demolition rates lower than the bigger companies?
a: No franchise royalty built into the quote — Live Junk Free is local and independent, with our own insured crew and trucks. The identical demolition job, handled just as carefully, simply costs less.
